comment: timeout.c nh_timeout() 819-821 and eat.c eating_dangerous_corpse() 487: a debug Caveman wishes for a blessed black naga corpse (acidic, 43 turns to eat), sets acid resistance to a 5-turn timeout with #wizintrinsic (page 2, count 5), and eats the corpse from the floor. When the timeout runs out mid-meal, nh_timeout() sees he is eating an acidic corpse and extends the resistance one turn at a time until he finishes.
